name: 100x-localize
description: Validation tooling for the 100x-localize skill (LocalizationBundle output contract). Not published -- this package.json exists only so scripts/validate.js can pull in ajv for real JSON Schema enforcement (structural checks: required/additionalProperties/enum/pattern/if-then) instead of a hand-rolled re-implementation. Cross-field checks that JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express (axiom 1 compression-ratio ceiling/floor, axiom 4 fabricated-authority-claim detection) stay hand-written in scripts/validate.js -- see that file's header comment and axioms.md.
